notes.title: Soundtrack Out Now! Free upgrade for all existing customers!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've just released the soundtrack to [b]Haunt the House: Terrortown[/b] as DLC to the main game! Our composer [b]Raphael Benjamin Meyer[/b] did an amazing job, and his work really shines in the hands of the talented musicians he brought on board to play for us.

You can see some of them (and Raphael!) at work in the video we've added to the DLC page:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/421940/

We've also added a Soundtrack Edition which includes the game and the soundtrack DLC, at a slightly discounted price.

As a special thank you to everyone who already bought the game, [b]we've upgraded you all to the Soundtrack Edition![/b] If we hadn't, then the DLC would have had to be full price to all our early supporters, compared to the discounted bundle that new customers can get, and that just wouldn't be right.

We've also just released the soundtrack to our other game here on Steam, [b]Detective Grimoire[/b], also from our amazing composer Raphael Benjamin Meyer!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/421950/

We hope you enjoy them both!

Tom & Adam

notes.title: Another new free level - Ghost Train: Railroad Carnival!
notes.notes:
Happy Halloween everyone!

As promised, we've added a brand new level to Haunt the House: Terrortown!

All aboard the Railroad Carnival in the new [b]Ghost Train[/b] level!

A lively funfair perched precariously on the back of a train racing through the countryside, full of revelers to haunt! Three carriages; a 'haunted house', a carousel and a circus tent, each with lots of new items to possess and spooks to perform. Plus a new ghost to play as!

We've also added 15 new achievements, 5 for each of the new levels we've released since the original level.

With this free update, Haunt the House: Terrortown is now over [b]twice[/b] as large as it was when we launched last year, which is something we're very proud of. 

Once again, we want to ask that if you've left us a 'not recommended' review in the past because of the short length of the original game, please consider editing your review if you now think that it has enough content to warrant it!

Thanks everyone, and we hope you enjoy playing the new level!

Tom & Adam

notes.title: New free level added: Mansion House!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We still see some folks in the reviews who think the game is too short, so we're doing our best to fix that. We already released a free expansion level back in December, 'Haunt the Holidays', and we're working on another big new level in time for Halloween, which will also be a free update!

In the mean time, some of you may have played our 2010 Flash game 'Haunt the House' but a lot of you might not have! So to bridge the gap between now and the Halloween update in October, we've taken the Mansion House level from the original Flash game and ported it over into this game, as an extra free level to play! 

There are also a few small bug fixes, a neater title screen and all round improved performance!

If you can't wait to see what the Halloween level will have in store, there are a few sneaky previews on Adam's blog:

[url=http://adamvian.tumblr.com/post/127272314291/working-on-new-haunt-the-house-animations]Halloween level animations[/url]

If you previously left us a 'not recommended' review because of the size of the game, we hope you might consider editing your review once the game has enough content for you, it'd really help!

Enjoy the update and we'll see you in October!

Tom & Adam

notes.title: Haunt the Holidays! A free expansion update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've just launched an update to Haunt the House: Terrortown that features a brand new level to play, as well as a new ghost to play it as! 

We know a lot of you wanted more content, so we decided that for this festive season we'd put together a holiday-themed department store for you to haunt. 

Just let your game update and you'll find the new level right there on the title screen! You can see a new screenshot and short teaser trailer on the games Steam page.

We hope you enjoy it!

Tom & Adam

notes.title: We just launched Detective Grimoire on Steam! 30% off for the first week!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Back in February, Haunt the House: Terrortown was greenlit, and at the same time, it was joined by our other game Detective Grimoire.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/272600

Today we've finally released it here on Steam. So if you enjoyed Haunt the House, you might enjoy Detective Grimoire!

In HtH news, there's an update coming later this week that adds official PS3/PS4 controller support, as well as fixed the rare Mac crash. I'm just testing it a few more times then I'll push it live!

Cheers,
Tom-

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

It's time for the Steam Summer Sale, our first! For the duration of the sale, Haunt the House: Terrortown will be 10% off. That probably seems a little low, but I don't want everyone who bought the game for 20% off during the first week to feel cheated, since it's only been out 2 weeks!

If we do get picked for a feature spot in the sale, the game will be back to that same 20% off, but definitely no more than that until the next sale, later in the year!

Don't forget, Haunt the House: Terrortown has trading cards available, which go towards Steams Summer Adventure promotion during the sale!

Tom-
